purpose: Reduce Q normal-reference DEV false alarms with zero additional DEV attack misses; development evidence only.

model.numeric_path: E3 float32; standardize float64 with original mean/scale; append missing0; full row float32; P2 float32
model.e3_runtime: Existing e3_embed_v1 build_e3_runtime + embed_flows semantics; model eval, local_files_only, config.pretraining=False, compile=False, tokenizer.pretraining=True, raw_labels=False; no changes to old fixed-size CLI contracts

legacy.decision: float32 sigmoid then float64 comparison >= unchanged probability threshold
legacy.no_reference: Exact original R path. Original ID and old unrelated OOD/attacks do not receive this device-specific adaptation.

ID_anchor.use: Historical unchanged fallback row, explicitly reused; no new independent ID experiment or reopened arrays. Verify routing with synthetic no-reference equality.

immutable.Q_ensemble: Existing three final logits averaged with old numeric path; no new Q training or threshold.

data.split_rule: All reference-sharing components FIT; other whole components: SHA256(salt|device|component) mod5 ==0 CAL, otherwise FIT
data.reference_allowlist: Only original LEARN/DEV reference UIDs; REFERENCE manifest may contain other partitions, rejected at feature join; no HOLDOUT queries or references used.
data.CAL_limits: Held out from new helpers/verifiers only; existing Q and old foundation are not newly held out. No independence certification.
data.metadata_uses: Routing, causal masks, supervised targets/weights, split and auditing only; no DEV optimizer or CAL optimizer.

routing.outer: Retain existing registration validation: unregistered/no validated device reference -> original R; registered valid reference -> exact frozen Q.
routing.inner: Verifier usable only with >=2 distinct same-protocol original normal reference components and entire bank reference_end < query timestamp.
routing.equation: alarm_new = alarm_Q AND NOT(inner_valid AND verifier_score > cut)
routing.fallback: Invalid/insufficient/empty inner references -> exact Q. Empty-inner control keeps outer registration fixed.
routing.reference_contamination: Clean normal commissioning is assumed, not demonstrated under pollution.
routing.probability_claim: No composite calibrated probability is defined.

verifier.architecture: shared W64x768, no bias: u=unit(z); e=unit(W u); same W for queries and references
verifier.z: original frozen standardization float64 then float32, missing-indicator excluded
verifier.score: mean top min(2,n) cosine similarities to distinct same-protocol reference components; deploy n>=2; train n>=1
verifier.raw_baseline: unit(z768), same score/gate/calibration, no W and no training
verifier.normalization: float32 L2 vector_norm; require finite norm >1e-12; division by actual norm, no dataset refit
verifier.numeric: float32 forward; finite cosine within [-1-1e-5,1+1e-5], clamp to [-1,1]; float64 average of seed scores in seed order
verifier.ties: reference UID lexicographic tie break; bank name lexicographic tie break
verifier.gradient: Gradients flow through query and reference projections; no detached reference branch during training
verifier.failure: Nonfinite/norm/identity/shape/causality violation stops the run; never silently remove rows.

hard_normal_helpers.architecture: Old Q residual 14385 parameters initialized from frozen R, not from trained Q. Original empty-reference gate is active using legitimate device registration.
hard_normal_helpers.train: FIT from four other devices only; all CAL and the two held devices excluded; recompute exact hierarchical class-balanced weights on that subset.
hard_normal_helpers.OOF: Score only held-device FIT normals using mean final helper logits and unchanged original threshold/numeric sigmoid.
hard_normal_helpers.H: Union of normal FIT UIDs flagged by the helper ensemble for their fixed held-device fold; seal UIDs/weights once, shared across both verifier arms.

feasibility_gate.on_failure: STOP_NO_HARD_TRANSFER_SIGNAL before verifier training; no fold/threshold retune
feasibility_gate.interpretation: Prospective practical requirement for this hard-normal supervision premise, not statistical power and not proof all reference learning is impossible.

hard_normal_helpers.limits: Only Q residual supervision is device-held-out. Frozen R/E3 may retain prior knowledge. H is training data, not an independent result.
hard_normal_helpers.claim: No separately established causal benefit for H without a future dedicated ablation.

training.FULL_attack_score: max score over ALL earlier same-protocol LEARN device banks including own; n>=1 at training; no pooled synthetic devices
training.NO_CF_attack_score: own earlier original reference bank only
training.weighting: For a single-class subset, equal device -> activity/mode -> capture -> session -> row, each branch normalized to sum1. w_normal=.25*w_all_normal+.25*w_H; w_attack=.5*w_all_attack. Total sum1.
training.minibatch_loss: N / actual_batch_size * sum(w_i * loss_i); no batch renormalization
training.budget_rule: epoch is 0-based; budgets[epoch % 3]; per bank/protocol take hash-first min(budget,n), no replacement; allqueries in epoch share bank subset
training.reference_subset_hash: SHA256(salt|seed|epoch0|device|protocol|reference_uid), then uid; UTF-8 and decimal integers
training.bank_time: entire bank reference_end must be strictly less than query timestamp, including under subset sampling and donor use
training.initialization: torch.manual_seed(seed); allocate bare W64x768; torch.nn.init.orthogonal_(W,gain=1); no RNG-consuming module init before W
training.helper_initialization: Old Residual(Q) constructor after torch.manual_seed(seed); fold and arm not added to seed.
training.ordering: Preserve original manifest/cache UID order after subset selection; independent CPU torch.Generator(seed), randperm once per epoch; each FIT UID exactly once. FULL/NO_CF share exact orders and subset hashes.
training.numeric: CPU deterministic PyTorch ops; 4 threads/worker; AdamW foreach=False; no mixed precision; weights/loss accumulation float64, forward/backward parameters float32
training.endpoint: 40th epoch only; no early stopping/checkpoint selection or automatic retries

calibration.time: Only after all six verifier endpoints and H sealed; no optimization afterwards.
calibration.population: All 115672 CAL attacks; 359875 eligible earlier LEARN bank contexts; same protocol and >=2 components; no Q-positive filter. No CAL normal used to choose cut.
calibration.bank_use: All available references per qualifying bank; top2 on full bank upper-bounds every legal subset for the same query and bank.
calibration.formula: cut = max(0, max over CAL_attack, eligible_LEARN_bank of score) + 1e-5
calibration.ensemble: score=mean of the three scores for the SAME bank; then maximum over banks/attacks, not mean of three maxima
calibration.comparison: Strict score > cut only; no equality cancellation
calibration.no_useful_cut: cut >=1 gives no cancellations; record NO_USEFUL_CORRECTION; do not loosen
calibration.check: Reapply sealed cut to all calibration contexts and require exactly zero observed attack cancellations.

evaluation.order: Cache/base parity -> helpers/H gate -> six endpoints -> CAL seals -> one DEV evaluation including all prespecified controls -> seal/report
evaluation.primary: Frozen Q ensemble plus mean verifier scores; all 179886 original DEV rows remain in denominator.
evaluation.individuals: All FULL/NO_CF individual seeds with corresponding Q seed and separately prespecified CAL cut; never select best seed.
evaluation.budget16: Per protocol hash-first min(16,n) own refs using metadata control salt; no retune; gate still needs2.

system_gate.meaning: Useful development milestone; halving a 48.37% focal false alarm rate is not yet a deployable low-FPR or paper success.

evaluation.learned_mechanism: FULL passes system gate, lower weighted normal FPR than RAW at zero new DEV misses, and Pareto joint advantage over NO_CF (no higher added attack misses/no higher weighted FPR, at least one strict). Otherwise separate unsupported component from useful system gain.
evaluation.personalization: For matched correct vs wrong, >=1 DEV device must have strictly lower hierarchically weighted normal FPR and no more added attack misses, with >=2/3 individual seeds showing same direction. Report both devices and all protocols; no dropping TCP fallback.
required_reports: new misses relative Q and affected/wholly missed sessions
CUT value and CAL attack tail
OOF H distribution including hard novel annotated activities
old ID/history reused only, missing independent ID explicitly
evaluation.uncertainty: Descriptive grouped differences only; no packet-binomial confidence or risk certificate with 2 DEV devices.
evaluation.HOLDOUT: No automatic opening even if DEV gate passes; separate prospective authorization required.
evaluation.claim_limit: No new proof of historical same-name-family 91.91% improvement, all-protocol coverage, real simultaneous shared-network traffic or attack-contaminated commissioning.

runtime_plan.cache_local_availability: Large feature arrays omitted from pulled results; future matching cache export/availability audit needed, no full pipeline rerun.
runtime_plan.frozen_R_inputs: May derive/cache z,h_R,b_R once during separately authorized execution; preserve old normalizer and state pins.
runtime_plan.performance: Resource ceiling only, not ETA; no separate resource trial. User handles upload/submission/pullback.
runtime_plan.failure: STOPPED_NO_RETRY, preserve completed endpoints and exact failing stage; no automatic restart.
runtime_plan.status: Persistent stage+completed/total_updates+epoch+elapsed+error+final seal; user-readable one-command view; no polling automation created.
runtime_plan.package_acceptance: Python3.9 real runtime APIs, LF shell files, clean Linux dependency closure including report metadata, mock failure/export/status; unchanged Q replay on cached features before new training.

implementation_acceptance: No HOLDOUT loader/optimizer route; CAL excluded from all helper/verifier gradients; reference roles allowlisted
Whole component split and exact UID/weight/exposure hashes, helper-held-device exclusion
Frozen Q/R tensors/numerical replay; inner-empty exact Q; outer-unregistered exact R
Causal full-bank masks, distinct components, same protocol, no future/query context appended
Singleton legal for training, >=2 for inference; padding never counted; query/ref gradient flow
Worst-bank and top2 numeric/tie/monotonic subset checks; deterministic three-seed averaging
Max CAL cut and strict ties; veto never creates new positive; finite/norm fail-closed run behavior
Matched correct/wrong exact UID/count/protocol/time; all denominators unchanged
Synthetic clean end-to-end report dependencies, status, failure/no-retry, seal readback

decision_if_failed.H_gate: This error-supervision premise is unavailable; do not train verifiers blindly.
decision_if_failed.raw_pass_full_no_gain: Prefer simpler useful evidence; learned innovation unsupported, no automatic promotion.
decision_if_failed.cut0_gains_but_safe_cut_no_gain: Attack/normal evidence not separated sufficiently; threshold relaxation is not a solution.
decision_if_failed.CAL_protected_DEV_attack_loss: Protection did not transfer; examine new attack misses and reference dependence, no risk guarantee.
decision_if_failed.correct_equals_wrong: General normal recognition may help, but device-reference personalization unsupported.
decision_if_failed.all_fail: Record bounded negative mechanism evidence; do not claim entire route impossible or run adjacent hyperparameters automatically.
